subtitles.zh: 很多人欣赏你的乐观并为此振奋。
subtitles.en: Many people appreciate your optimism and get excited by it.

subtitles.zh: 但如果你的乐观最终被证明是错的呢？
subtitles.en: But what if your optimism proves wrong in the end?

subtitles.zh: 那我可以说我已竭尽所能。原因在于我不仅乐观，更在全力创造一项技术，
subtitles.en: Then I can say that I did everything I could. And the reason for that is because not only my optimistic, I'm doing everything I can to create a technology

subtitles.zh: 以保障行业的安全与可靠。
subtitles.en: necessary to keep the industry safe, secure.

subtitles.zh: 所以，我们不要一边悲观地谈论未来，一边却无所作为去防止它发生。
subtitles.en: And so let's not talk about the future in a pessimistic way while we do nothing about it to prevent that from happening.

subtitles.zh: 也许我年纪大了，更像家长心态。
subtitles.en: And so maybe I'm older and more parental.

subtitles.zh: 不要只传递坏消息。
subtitles.en: Don't just deliver to bad news.

subtitles.zh: 告诉我你打算怎么应对。只要我们能证明自己在兼顾两面，
subtitles.en: Tell me what you're going to do about it. And so long as we can prove to ourselves that we're doing both sides of that coin,

subtitles.zh: 既追求乐观的未来，又在过程中守护我们的方式。
subtitles.en: the optimistic future while safeguarding our way in doing so.

subtitles.zh: 只要我们兼顾这两面，我就完全没问题。在AIPOM旋风般的一周后，有一件事很清楚。
subtitles.en: So long as we do both sides of that, I'm perfectly fine. After a whirlwind week of AIPOM, one thing was clear.

subtitles.zh: 黄仁勋一直是人工智能非凡新时代的主要倡导者。
subtitles.en: Jensen Wong has been the leading evangelist for an extraordinary new age of artificial intelligence.

subtitles.zh: 在英伟达，美国经济，甚至整个全球金融体系可能都依赖于他的乐观和成就。

subtitles.en: And even as in Vidya grew into one of the world's most powerful companies, there's still no one designated to potentially replace him.

subtitles.zh: 所以，我们不要一边悲观地谈论未来，一边却无所作为去防止它发生。
subtitles.en: And so let's not talk about the future in a pessimistic way while we do nothing about it to prevent that from happening.

subtitles.zh: 也许我年纪大了，更像家长心态。
subtitles.en: And so maybe I'm older and more parental.

subtitles.zh: 不要只传递坏消息。
subtitles.en: Don't just deliver to bad news.

subtitles.zh: 告诉我你打算怎么应对。只要我们能证明自己在兼顾两面，
subtitles.en: Tell me what you're going to do about it. And so long as we can prove to ourselves that we're doing both sides of that coin,

subtitles.zh: 既追求乐观的未来，又在过程中守护我们的方式。
subtitles.en: the optimistic future while safeguarding our way in doing so.

subtitles.zh: 只要我们兼顾这两面，我就完全没问题。在AIPOM旋风般的一周后，有一件事很清楚。
subtitles.en: So long as we do both sides of that, I'm perfectly fine. After a whirlwind week of AIPOM, one thing was clear.

subtitles.zh: 黄仁勋一直是人工智能非凡新时代的主要倡导者。
subtitles.en: Jensen Wong has been the leading evangelist for an extraordinary new age of artificial intelligence.

subtitles.zh: 在英伟达，美国经济，甚至整个全球金融体系可能都依赖于他的乐观和成就。
subtitles.en: In Vidya, the US economy, maybe even the entire global financial system might just rest on his optimism and accomplishments.

subtitles.zh: 但现在，黄仁勋本人正受到审视。自33年前公司创立以来，他一直领导着这家企业。
subtitles.en: But now, Wong himself is under scrutiny. He has led the business since its very beginning 33 years ago.

subtitles.zh: 尽管英伟达已成长为全球最强大的公司之一，但仍没有指定任何人可能接替他。
subtitles.en: And even as in Vidya grew into one of the world's most powerful companies, there's still no one designated to potentially replace him.
